meta.scenario: EV-only volume_moderate v2 p90 peakrisk pv_ess multiseed physical oracle
meta.gridOnlyDefinition: No PV, no ESS dispatch, no sharing, no SAC/MILP; every station serves all EV demand from the grid.
meta.defaultDefinition: Passive-PV baseline: no ESS dispatch, no sharing, no SAC/MILP; PV immediately offsets same-station EV demand and surplus is curtailed.
meta.gridProfileNote: PV/EV actual and forecast values are aggregated directly from the experiment CSV by date/hour. Method grid curves are exact offline counterfactual traces: local/soft/shared SAC are the seed 1/2/42 checkpoint replay mean, Forecast MILP is forecast-plan actual settlement, and MILP+MILP is the physical total-tariff oracle solve.
meta.stationDemandNote: Station-level EV curves are date/hour values from the EV-only volume_moderate shift048 scenario CSV; solid lines show demand_actual and dashed lines show demand_forecast after the configured station shifts.
meta.resultAggregation: Decision cost/saving metrics are 3-seed mean for seeds 1, 2, and 42.
meta.dashboardReplayPolicy: Map/MQTT replay remains a representative seed1-style sharing animation; operation-detail Grid curves use recomputed per-hour counterfactual traces.
meta.dashboardReplayConstraints: Per-station |share_energy_kwh| <= 300 and each frame is zero-sum.

gridTraceSource.sacTrace: 3-seed mean checkpoint replay with contract guard
gridTraceSource.milpTrace: CBC LP/MILP solve using five-method artifact options
